oneOf.description: An announcement channel: `@everyone` posts only in threads by default.
A 1:1 DM (no space, slug or name; always private).
A group DM of up to 9 people.

MgmtChannelNotAdded.description: A listed member the create did not add, and why.

member.description: The member as the request named it.

MgmtChannelNotAddedReason.description:
Why a listed member was not added to the channel (a ban is not a reason here: a
banned member is in `skipped`).

oneOf.description: No member has this id or external id (provision first).
An assistant never joins a channel (it reads through its person).
A guest outside the Space (an App's Space takes no guests through channel adds).
Not a member of the Space: add it with `spaces/members/add` first.

MgmtSpaceMemberRef.description: A principal and its member id.

description: Response of `POST /mgmt/v1/channels/create`, each member list in request order.

added.description:
Listed members this call added. The owner, who is always a member, is never here; when
listed it is in `already`.

already.description: Listed members that were in the channel already.

name.description: Its current name (a repeat never changes it).

not_added.description: Listed members that cannot join, with the reason.

private.description: Whether it is private (current; a repeat never changes it).

skipped.description:
Listed members a Space ban keeps out (member ids, the shape of `members/add`). Always
present.

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).

type.description: Its type, `text` or `voice` (additive; absent from an older Sew = text).

user_limit.description: Voice only (additive): its current per-channel limit, 0 = none. Absent for text.
